<div class="card-body">
'''Blizzard 1''' is a [[Dark]] [[Vehicle]] ([[Combat Vehicle]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ブリザード1</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">2名のパイロットと8名の乗客を搭乗させられる。対：損耗＜4。「AT-ATレーザー砲」を使用して「目標、メイン・ジェネレーター」を試みる際、合計値に1を加える。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Blizzard-1-Encyclopedia32-original.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ヴィアーズ将軍のAT-AT。<u>密閉型</u>。高度な通信装置を内蔵。実験的な照準システムを搭載している。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Blizzard 1

'''Card text:''' Can carry 2 pilots and 8 passengers. Immune to attrition &lt; 4. When using an AT-AT Laser Cannon to attempt Target The Main Generator, add 1 to the total.

'''Lore:''' General Veers' AT-AT. Enclosed. Has advanced communications equipment built in. Equipped with an experimental targeting system.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese names the weapon AT-ATレーザー砲 (“AT-AT Laser Cannon”), where the original English names [[AT-AT Cannon]].
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Blizzard 1]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
